reviews.title: Worst production ever
reviews.text:
If your gonna host a boxing match that goes on for 5 hours and people pay good money for atleast make it decent, the first 2 Fights were overweight men who don’t know how to box showing their @ss, Leaning on the ropes and wasting time.

Tesehki vs lex was the biggest fix i’ve ever seen, we’ve watched tesehki fight for seasons and the girl demolishes every person she’s against, Firstly her instagram was deactivated, then the press conference she wasn’t herself and then she loses and fights like she’s never fought before.

Baddies/zues was great while it lasted but after that fight i think its ran its course, ive never cancelled a subscription quicker.
